expected_behavior: Shows Turnkey client initialization with @turnkey/sdk-server and env vars
Checks for existing wallets before creating a new one
Creates an HD wallet with an Ethereum account

Delegates to creating-wallets-sdk for chain details and signing-transactions-sdk for advanced patterns

query: Build me a treasury management service with Turnkey. I need hot and cold wallets with multi-party approval for large transfers.
expected_behavior: Creates separate wallets for hot and cold storage
Sets up user tags and API-only users for role-based access

Shows consensus error handling when approval is needed
Delegates to managing-policies-sdk for policy language details

query: I want to automate ERC-20 token payouts using Turnkey. The service should send USDC to a list of recipients with spending limits.
expected_behavior: Shows wallet setup with Ethereum account
